title: Document triage
description: Classify an incoming document, say how urgent its handling is, and judge whether it needs a human step. The score axis is urgency like every other domain: the generator's phrase banks are tone-shaped (calm → urgent), so a confidence axis would label urgent text with a confidence level. Documented as a design decision in BACKLOG B-5.

instructions.choice: How should this document be classified?
instructions.score: How urgent is this document request?

option_descriptions.contract: contracts, agreements, clauses, signatures, addenda, and renewal terms
option_descriptions.invoice: invoices, receipts, purchase orders, expense claims, and payment terms
option_descriptions.other: everything else: resumes, policies, memos, press releases, and office notes
option_descriptions.report: reports, spreadsheets, decks, audits, forecasts, and analysis documents

calm: The {entity} can wait until next month.
distractor: There is also a {distractor} on file.
neutral: The {entity} was discussed in the meeting.
request: Please take care of the {entity} before filing.
Could you handle the {entity} for us?
I would like the {entity} done this week.
We need help with the {entity} before the deadline.
urgent: The {entity} is needed before the deadline, right now!
Escalating the {entity} immediately, the audit starts!
